system.description:
Seasoned troops may be privileged enough to be issued heavy armor, comprising metal (usually ring or chain mail, with occasional plate protection) over quilted padding, including head protection (probably a chain coif). Not the traditional "plate-mail," which evolves several centuries later.

Negative Traits: Clumsy, Heavy

Concealability: Long cloak to None

Availability: Resources x3, Rare
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
